_source.title: 使用立创 C 编号批量获取器件
_source.remarks.text.0: 默认情况下，如果在同一个库内匹配到多个相同 C 编号的器件，将只会返回第一个结果；
_source.remarks.text.1: 如果希望返回多个结果，请将 `allowMultiMatch` 置为 `true`；
_source.remarks.text.2: 私有化部署环境暂无法使用本接口
_source.params.lcscIds: 立创 C 编号数组
_source.params.libraryUuid: 库 UUID，默认为系统库，可以使用 {@link LIB_LibrariesList} 内的接口获取
_source.params.allowMultiMatch: 是否允许单个立创 C 编号匹配多个结果
_source.returns: 搜索到的器件属性的列表

title: Batch get devices using LCSC C numbers
remarks.text.0: By default, if multiple devices with the same C number are matched in the same library, only the first result will be returned;
remarks.text.1: If you want to return multiple results, set `allowMultiMatch` to `true`;
remarks.text.2: This API is temporarily unavailable in the private deployment environment
params.libraryUuid: Library UUID, default is system library, you can use {@link LIB_LibrariesList} APIs in
params.allowMultiMatch: Whether a single LCSC C number is allowed to match multiple results
